scholarships.title: Arab Fund Fellowship for Academic Excellence (برنامج الزمالات للتميز الأكاديمي)
scholarships.official_source: Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development (AFESD)

eligibility: Not a previous beneficiary of the Fellowship - previous beneficiaries are not eligible to re-apply
Intended activity is advanced research and/or teaching at a foreign university
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to Arab PhD holders who have not previously received an Arab Fund fellowship. The Fund describes the fellowship as a bridge for outstanding Arab Ph.D. holders to lecture or conduct advanced research at world-renowned universities.
benefits: Round-trip airfare for the beneficiary and eligible members of their family
Health and personal accident insurance for the duration of the stay
coverage: Round-trip airfare for the beneficiary and eligible members of their family
Health and personal accident insurance for the duration of the stay
requirements: Hold a PhD and be an Arab national
Secure placement at a foreign university to conduct advanced research and/or teach
Submit the application at least one year before the expected start date of the stay
Not have been a previous beneficiary of the Fellowship
application_method: Register and submit the application through the Arab Fund's electronic services portal for the fellowship service
Submit at least one year before the intended start of the stay at the host university
existing.selection_notes: The Fund describes the selection pool as Arab scholars 'in different fields of specialization who have excellent academic track record'. Previous beneficiaries cannot re-apply.
existing.best_fit: Arab PhD holders employed in academia or research who need a funded research and teaching stay at a leading university outside the Arab region.
existing.notes: This is a research and academic-activity fellowship, not a degree-enrolment scholarship: the PhD must already be held. The official pages do not publish the value of the maintenance allowance, so no funding figure is recorded. The official page also points to Bibliotheca Alexandrina's list of other higher-education funding opportunities, which is not part of this award.
existing.duration: Usually 12 months; shorter periods are considered only in very special cases
existing.application_period: Continuous intake; applications must be submitted at least one year before the expected starting date of the stay at the foreign university
